This is a WHO vs WHY error. The author focuses on the person (Alito) rather than the legal logic, baiting a moral critique of his character.

By projecting past prejudices onto current groups, the dissent maintains a cycle of exclusion. It uses judicial pretext to justify a personal bias against the very path that enabled the justice's own rise.
